setup: PS1='student@node01:~$ '; source /usr/share/bash-completion/bash_completion; source <(kubectl completion bash); alias k=kubectl; complete -o default -F __start_kubectl k; mkdir work && cd work && touch a.yaml b.yml c.json notes.txt Upper.YAML mixed.Yaml dot. && mkdir dir; clear

cases.name: verbs-with-descriptions
cases.note: r: replace, rollout, run share only r; the second Tab lists them with descriptions.
outputs:
replace  (Replace a resource by file name or stdin)
rollout  (Manage the rollout of a resource)
run      (Run a particular image on the cluster)
student@node01:~$ kubectl r

cases.note: The descriptions are cut to the 40 columns with an ellipsis.
